refnamediv.refpurpose: Negate the value in a node

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeNegate function negates the value of object. If object is a leaf node holding an error, SilikoNodeNegate does nothing. If object is a leaf node holding an integer then the value is multiplied by -1 in place. If object is a leaf node represending a real, then the value is multiplied by -1.0 in place. If object is a branch node, then a flag is toggled to negate the value when object is evaluated.
